metaTitle: Custom Recycled PET Cables & Cords | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom recycled PET cables and cords for your brand. Eco-friendly lanyards and more. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Recycled PET cables and cords give you a durable, eco-friendly alternative to standard nylon or polyester. Made from post-consumer plastic bottles, these lanyards and keychains appeal to sustainability-conscious clients and trade show attendees. Choose from multiple widths and custom imprint colors to match your brand. They work well for events, employee IDs, or promotional giveaways where environmental impact matters.
heroAltText: Custom recycled PET cables and cords in assorted colors with imprinted logos, ideal for eco-friendly lanyards.
